news.title: New underwater robot, developed by IE's She, could make ocean missions more reliable
news.summary_en: Prototype is able to adapt to needs of mission, acting as drifter, glider and thruster

news.title: David Corti named head of the Davidson School of Chemical Engineering
news.summary_en: David S. Corti has been named the next Jay and Cynthia Ihlenfeld Head of the Davidson School of Chemical Engineering, effective Aug. 17, 2026.

news.title: College of Engineering recognizes top-rated teachers
news.summary_en: Purdue University's College of Engineering recognized faculty, lecturers and staff members for their outstanding dedication to teaching in an Aug. 24 Purdue Exponent advertisement.

news.title: AAE's Kwok and IE's She receive NASA award to enable long-duration space missions
news.summary_en: $899,738 Phase II STTR award will fund 2-year activity to develop robotic welding technology

news.title: August Edition: Newly Issued Patents
news.summary_en: Congratulations to Purdue University researchers who recently received 17 patents on their intellectual property from the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office.

news.title: Purdue’s high-speed propulsion lab achieves internationally recognized quality management certification
news.summary_en: ISO 9001 will help facilitate partnerships with defense and aerospace industries

news.title: Purdue Baja Racing: A Year of Firsts
news.summary_en: Since 1983, Purdue Baja Racing has designed and built a new single-seat off-road vehicle every year, competing against the best universities in the world. In 2026 Purdue Baja topped the podium, winning 1st place for the first time in its history.
